[CUT]

CAMERA: Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.

CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Firm): "She is innocent."

CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.
JULIANA (Breathless, Relieved): "Your Grace..."
CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.
DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Shouting): "I know what happened to me!"
CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.
DOWAGER DUCHESS (Fierce, Condemning): "I was poisoned!"
DOWAGER DUCHESS (Accusing): "And you... you knew!"
CAMERA: Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

CAMERA: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.
CATHERINE (Cruel, Condescending): "Look at you."
CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.
CATHERINE (Mocking, Venomous): "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.
CATHERINE (Taunting): "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.
JULIANA (Defiant, Steady): "You seem very pleased."
CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.
CATHERINE (Smug, Chilling): "I am."
CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.
CATHERINE (Whispering, Sinister): "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.
CATHERINE (Scornful): "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.
CATHERINE (Amused, Spiteful): "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.
JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken): "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.
CATHERINE (Cold, Bitter): "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
CAMERA: Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
CATHERINE (Gloating): "Do you remember?"
ACTION: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
CATHERINE (Viciously Delighted): "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
CAMERA: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
SOUND FX: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
CATHERINE (Quietly Venomous): "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
CAMERA: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.
JULIANA (Proud, Measured): "Gerald chose money."
JULIANA (Resolute): "Clarissa chose a coward."
JULIANA (Unyielding): "I chose myself."
CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.
CATHERINE (Disgusted): "You chose a beggar."
CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.
JULIANA (Fierce, Proud): "I chose a man."
CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.
CATHERINE (Contemptuous): "A scarred nobody."
CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.
JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified): "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.
CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking): "You call that marriage?"
CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.
JULIANA (Pure, Sincere): "I call it love."
CAMERA: High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.
CATHERINE (Mocking, Hysterical Laugh): "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.
JULIANA (Firm, Piercing): "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."
CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.
CATHERINE (Incredulous, Offended): "You think love makes you better than me?"
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.
JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."
CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.
CATHERINE (Incensed, Boastful): "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.
JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful): "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."
CAMERA: Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.
CATHERINE (Sneering, Derisive): "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"
CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.
CATHERINE (Arrogant, Elitist): "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."
CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.
JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative): "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
ACTION: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.
JULIANA (Accusatory, Commanding): "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."
CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.
CATHERINE (Enraged Scream): "Enough!"
CAMERA: Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.
SOUND FX: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
CAMERA: Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.
CATHERINE (Hateful, Malicious): "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
ACTION: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping): "[gasping] Give it back!"
CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.
CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic): "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.
JULIANA (Screaming, Agonized): "No!"
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.
CATHERINE (Vicious, Final): "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."
CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
ACTION: Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.
CAMERA: Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.
